summary: The Hybrid Loop Fabric registry and contract were fetched and validated for the AION lane, but the mandatory requests/aion/latest.json pointer returned GitHub 404 on two direct reads. The installed chatgpt-hybrid-loop-bridge workflow reported zero workflow runs, so no immutable request_id, unresolved backlog, or required_result_path exists to process.
